---
applyTo: "**"
guidelines:
  summaries:
    createMdFiles: false
    allowLongSummaries: false
    rule: "Always give only ISSUE + SOLUTION in short form."
  responses:
    concise: true
    avoidBoilerplate: true
    directActionable: true
  code:
    cleanCoding: true
    minimalExamples: true
    avoidUnnecessaryComments: true
  reviews:
    focusOnIssuesThenSolutions: true
    shortSpecificFeedback: true
  explanations:
    simpleLanguage: true
    shortExamples: true
format:
  template:
    issue: "Describe the issue in 1–2 lines."
    solution: "Give solution in 1–2 lines or minimal code."
